products.title: Personalized Happy Birthday Name Banner
products.description_html:
A two-line birthday banner: HAPPY BIRTHDAY on one line and your child's name on the other.

Choose a palette and enter the name when you order. The name in the photos is a sample.

This option includes the two banner lines only — no hanging decorations and no table garland.

products.title: Birthday Party Decoration Set
products.description_html:
One coordinated set that decorates the party space, so you don't have to match pieces yourself.

  • Personalized banner — HAPPY BIRTHDAY and your child's name (2 lines)
  • Hanging decorations — 2 separate strands of 6 pieces each (12 pieces)
  • Table garland — 1 strand for the front edge of the party table

Five strands in total. Cake and cupcake toppers are not included in this option — see the Complete Party Set.

products.title: Complete Birthday Party Set with Cake & Cupcake Toppers
products.description_html:
Everything from the Birthday Party Decoration Set plus matching toppers for the cake and cupcakes.

  • Personalized banner — HAPPY BIRTHDAY and your child's name (2 lines)
  • Hanging decorations — 2 strands of 6 pieces each
  • Table garland — 1 strand for the party table
  • Cake topper — personalized with your child's name
  • Cupcake toppers — a matching set

products.title: Personalized Birthday Cake Topper
products.description_html:
A cake topper with a mini banner personalized with your child's name, in a palette that matches our party sets.

The name in the photos is a sample.

products.title: Birthday Cupcake Toppers
products.description_html: A set of cupcake toppers — rainbows, clouds and more — in a palette that matches our party sets.
